fields.title: Arrow Effect
fields.description: Variant of `mob_effect` that derives the effects from the arrow's tipped-potion data and splits durations across the standard eight-arrow stack.

fields.title: Catch Fire
fields.description: Causes the projectile to embed itself in the block it hits.

fields.title: Definition Event
fields.description: Fires an entity event on the shooter, the projectile, the entity hit, and/or all entities in a splash radius.

fields.title: Douse Fire
fields.description: When the projectile is a water-effect potion, extinguishes fires and campfires at and around the hit block.

fields.title: Freeze On Hit
fields.description: Freezes nearby water blocks to ice in a configurable volume around the impact (Education Edition chemistry feature).

fields.title: Grant Xp
fields.description: Drops experience orbs at the impact location.

fields.title: Hurt Owner
fields.description: Damages the projectile's owner when the projectile lands.

fields.title: Ignite
fields.description: Triggers the entity's `on_ignite` definition when the projectile hits.

fields.title: Impact Damage
fields.description: Deals damage to the entity that was hit and optionally applies knockback, fire, channeling, and critical-hit scaling.

fields.title: Mob Effect
fields.description: Applies one or more mob effects to the entity hit. Effects are described with an `effects` array of effect objects.

fields.title: Particle On Hit
fields.description: Emits a particle effect at the impact location, optionally only for entity hits or only for non-entity hits.

fields.title: Remove On Hit
fields.description: Removes the projectile from the world when it hits a block, entity, or (if `hit_water` is set) water.

fields.title: Spawn Aoe Cloud
fields.description: Spawns an area effect cloud at the impact point that applies potion effects to entities inside it over time

fields.title: Spawn Chance
fields.description: Conditionally spawns one or two groups of entities at the impact location and optionally fires events on each spawned entity.

fields.title: Stick In Ground
fields.description: Causes the projectile to embed itself in the block it hits.

fields.title: Teleport Owner
fields.description: Teleports the projectile's owner to the impact location.

fields.title: Thrown Potion Effect
fields.description: Applies the splash-potion effects of a thrown potion to nearby entities at the impact point.

fields.title: Wind Burst On Hit
fields.description: Releases an outward wind burst at the impact point that pushes nearby entities away.
